# SOP-P2-L1-01 Line startup - Hot Forge line
Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P2, line P2-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L1-RR01, EQ-P2-L1-IH02, EQ-P2-L1-SB03

1. Preconditions
   1.1 Verify daily inspection logs are complete and present at the control desk.  
   1.2 Confirm no outstanding lockout/tagout per SB-1001 and SOP-P2-L1-04.  
   1.3 Confirm preventive maintenance permits cleared for EQ-P2-L1-RR01 and EQ-P2-L1-IH02.

2. Personal protective equipment (PPE)
   2.1 Mandatory: hearing protection, flame-resistant coveralls, safety glasses, steel-toe footwear.  
   2.2 Additional: respirators per SB-1030 when shot blast cabinet access is required.

3. Startup sequence
   3.1 Conduct visual inspection of EQ-P2-L1-SB03 and ensure access panels are secured.  
   3.2 Check dust collector differential and confirm: The dust collector pressure drop alarm for Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #3 (EQ-P2-L1-SB03) is 1240 Pa. If alarm condition present, abort startup and follow SB-1030.  
   3.3 Energize peripheral systems and confirm interlocks on EQ-P2-L1-IH02 are satisfied.  
   3.4 Perform a dry-run cycle of transfer conveyors and verify sensor feedback to PLC.  
   3.5 On EQ-P2-L1-RR01, verify mandrel clamp condition and confirm: The mandrel clamp bolt torque for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L1-RR01) is 430 N·m. If torque does not match recorded torque, secure with approved tools and retest before loading material.  
   3.6 Load first piece and run single-piece heat/roll sequence under supervision. Monitor alarms and emergency stops.

4. Abnormal conditions
   4.1 Any interlock, alarm, or abnormal vibration requires immediate stop and notification of maintenance per SB-1001.

5. Sign-off
   5.1 Operator prints name, signs, and records start time and equipment condition.  
   5.2 Shift lead reviews and initials completion of checks and authorizes production start.  
   5.3 Attach this form to the shift log and reference SOP-P2-L1-04 for detailed maintenance follow-up.
